Callout.Name: Trafficking - Lorry Intercept
Callout.Message: Lorry believed to be moving people into the county.
Callout.Advisory: Curtain-sided lorry, one driver, last seen on the highway.

Script.Line: I am the driver. I drive where I am told.
What is in the back is not mine. I never look in the back.
They paid me in cash and they paid me a lot. That tells you everything about what I am.

Lines.Briefing: There are people in the back of that lorry. Whatever happens, they are not the suspects.
Lines.Approach: It is a curtain-sider and it has not stopped at the last two checks. Get it off the road.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
